# Test fixtures

`tiny.heic` (one 64x48 image), `multi.heic` (two 64x48 images) and `rotated.heic` (64x48 red/blue halves stored with an `irot` 90° rotation, displays as 48x64 with red on top) are synthetic images generated by [`generate.sh`](generate.sh): gradient pixels computed in Python (stdlib only), then encoded with `heif-enc` 1.23.4 (libheif) using the x265 4.1 HEVC encoder. They contain no camera data, no EXIF/XMP and no photos or third-party images.

All other test images (JPEG with EXIF, PNG with alpha, a decompression-bomb PNG header) are generated in memory by `test/helpers.ts` at test time.

Synthetic images generated by generate.sh (heif-enc 1.23.4 / x265 4.1), no camera data. Dedicated to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

HEVC encoding here is a one-off internal step for tests; `test/` is not included in the npm package.
